copy.tagline: 决定如何将已完成分支合并到主分支
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发完成需要决定分支合并策略
copy.tagline_en: Decide how to integrate a completed branch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide how to merge a finished development branch

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成开发分支的收尾工作：先运行全部测试，然后根据环境（普通仓库或分离 HEAD）展示选项列表，等你选择合并、创建 Pull Request 或保留分支，并按你的选择执行操作和清理工作。
howto.when: 当你完成分支实现、所有测试通过，需要决定如何将工作集成到主仓库时触发。

say.text: 测试都过了，帮我完成这个分支。
say.note: Claude 会运行测试并展示选项菜单。

say.text: 合并分支到 base 分支。
say.note: Claude 会执行本地合并并清理工作树。
Claude 会推送分支并引导你创建 PR。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through finishing a development branch: runs full test suite, detects environment (normal repo or detached HEAD), presents a menu of options (merge locally, push and create PR, keep as-is), executes your choice, and cleans up worktree if needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementation on a branch is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work into the main repository.

say_en.text: Tests pass, please finish this branch.
say_en.note: Claude runs tests and shows the option menu.
Claude performs local merge and cleans up worktree.

say_en.text: Push and create a Pull Request.
say_en.note: Claude pushes the branch and helps create a PR.
